Thousands of Record Sources Clinician-Reviewed Summaries 100% Compliant Delivered Into Your EHR $0 Upfront Cost The Problem Patient Records Are Scattered Across Thousands of Sources Your providers make decisions with incomplete information every day. Records fragmented across hospitals, specialists, labs, and pharmacies mean missed history, redundant tests, and care gaps that cost time and money. Records Consolidated 01 Patient records from thousands of sources across the healthcare continuum are retrieved and reconciled into a single working set for clinical review. Clinician-Ready Summaries 02 Complex histories are turned into a concise, H & P-style summary: objective, source-cited, and built for clinical decision-making. Delivered directly into your EHR. Billing Guidance Included 03 A procedural packet outlines applicable coding options and documentation rules so your team can apply them under your own billing policies. Your Team Stays Untouched 04 This is additive. Your existing billing team and clinical operations remain exactly as they are. No new systems, no retraining, no disruption. How It Works Three Steps to Complete Patient Records No downtime, no disruption, and no upfront investment required. 1 Consolidate Records from thousands of sources are retrieved and reconciled into a single working set. History, meds, allergies, labs, procedures, hospitalizations, and more. 2 Summarize Clinicians review the consolidated data and produce a concise, source-cited summary. The finished document is delivered directly into your EHR workflow. 3 Realize A billing procedural packet accompanies each summary, outlining applicable CPT codes and documentation rules. Your team applies them under your own policies. Benefits For Your Practice Less Time Chasing Records. More Time With Patients. Hours Back Per Provider No more tracking down records across portals and fax machines. Complete histories arrive consolidated, saving hours of staff time per patient. 01 Safer, More Informed Care Providers see the full picture before every encounter: meds, allergies, prior procedures, hospitalizations, and social history in one place. 02 Reduced Staff Burden Your clinical and admin staff stop spending time on manual record retrieval and reconciliation. The work is done before they open the chart. 03 Revenue That Follows the Work The same summaries that improve care also unlock billable CPT codes. Revenue is a byproduct of better documentation, not an extra task. 04 The Financial Model Performance-Based. Zero Risk. No upfront fees whatsoever If nothing collects, you pay nothing All providers accepting private insurance & Medicare Minimum 35,000 patients per practice Scales with your practice size Revenue scales with your patient volume and payer mix Why Blue Tree This Isn ’ t Another Billing Company Patient records are consolidated and summarized into a clinician-ready file. The revenue is a byproduct of better clinical documentation, not the other way around. Blue Tree Records + Revenue $ 99 Per Month ✓ Complete patient records from thousands of sources ✓ Clinician-reviewed summaries in your EHR ✓ Existing billing team untouched ✓ Zero upfront cost, performance-based ✓ Additive new revenue stream ✓ Improves clinical care quality Traditional Billing Billing Replacement $ 99 Per Month ✗ Setup fees & monthly minimums ✗ Disruption during transition ✗ Replaces existing billing staff ✗ Percentage of all revenue ✗ Optimizes same revenue pool ✗ No clinical care improvement Common Questions Everything You Need to Know Is this compliant? Absolutely. These are billable CPT codes that have long existed. The program makes it feasible to bill them at scale through advances in data aggregation and clinical summarization. Will this disrupt our current operations? No. The program integrates seamlessly alongside your existing processes. There is no downtime, no new systems to learn, and no changes to your current billing or clinical workflows. What does it cost? Zero upfront fees. The program ’ s fee is 6% of the new revenue it captures, billed after your insurance payments have been received. If nothing collects, you pay nothing. How many patients can we enroll? The program requires a minimum of 35,000 patients per practice. This scales with your practice size and can grow as your organization expands. Who handles the billing? A specialized, standalone billing partner manages all claims submission and collections. Your existing billing operations remain completely untouched. What types of practices are eligible?
